notes.bukhari:1536: Read both long own fields in full. notes.bukhari:1537: Both complete own fields supply the Ibn Umar olive-oil practice through the short Saeed ibn Jubayr attribution, the actual first-person mention to Ibrahim and his question, and the explicitly relayed Aswad/Aisha recollection of perfume shining in the hair part while the Prophet was in ihram. notes.bukhari:1543: Both complete fields supply the coherent short Ubaydullah/Ibn-Abbas attribution, Usama riding from Arafat to Muzdalifah, then Fadl riding from Muzdalifah to Mina, and Ibn Abbas's separately introduced statement that both reported continued talbiyah until the Jamrah-Aqabah stoning.
